import copy, hashlib, json, sys
from pathlib import Path
r=Path.cwd()
own=r/".tmp/stemrobin-184-six/n88-raw-assembly"
d=own/"authored-text-01"
t=own/"work/adapt/10c/modern-us-neutral/lessons/ana10-c6-s3-n88"
sys.path.insert(0,str(r/".claude/skills/ld-s10y-lesson/tools"))
import edition
errors=[]
checks=[]
def require(ok,label):
    checks.append({"check":label,"passed":bool(ok)})
    if not ok: errors.append(label)
def load(p): return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
def bind(p):
    b=p.read_bytes()
    return {"path":str(p),"bytes":len(b),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()}
base=load(d/"baseline-ledger.json")
profile=load(r/".claude/skills/ld-s10y-lesson/profiles/modern-us-neutral.json")
forbidden=profile.get("forbidden_terms",[])+profile.get("forbidden_person_names",[])
lesson=load(t/"lesson.template.json")
exercise=load(t/"exercises.template.json")
old_l=load(d/"before/lesson.template.json")
old_e=load(d/"before/exercises.template.json")
require(lesson.get("id")=="ana10-c6-s3-n88" and exercise.get("lesson")=="ana10-c6-s3-n88","N88-only identity")
require(lesson.get("status")=="draft" and exercise.get("status")=="draft","draft status preserved")
require(lesson.get("errata")==[],"no registered errata or correction invented")
change_rows=[]
exact_math=0
numeric=0
validated=0
for name,current,before,key,fields in [("lesson",lesson,old_l,"prose",{"text","changes"}),("exercises",exercise,old_e,"exercises",{"text","lines","changes"})]:
    left=copy.deepcopy(current)
    right=copy.deepcopy(before)
    left.pop(key,None)
    right.pop(key,None)
    if name=="lesson":
        left.pop("section_breaks",None)
        right.pop("section_breaks",None)
    require(left==right,name+" immutable top-level fields/source snapshot")
    items=current[key]
    prior=before[key]
    require(len(items)==len(prior),name+" item count/order")
    for i,(item,old) in enumerate(zip(items,prior)):
        label=name+"["+str(i)+"]"
        require({k:v for k,v in item.items() if k not in fields}=={k:v for k,v in old.items() if k not in fields},label+" immutable identity/refs/group/pages/figures/source fields")
        if item.get("kind") in {"fig","cap"}: require(item==old,label+" figure placeholder/caption unchanged")
        source=item.get("source_text","")
        text=item.get("text","")
        raw_math=[m.group(0) for m in edition.MATH.finditer(source)]
        modern_math=[m.group(0) for m in edition.MATH.finditer(text)]
        require(raw_math==modern_math,label+" exact math spans")
        exact_math+=len(raw_math)
        require(edition.number_signature(source)==edition.number_signature(text),label+" nonformula numeric signature")
        numeric+=len(edition.number_signature(source))
        found=edition.validate_text(source,text,item.get("changes"),item.get("numeric_changes"),label,forbidden,item.get("historical_entities"),[])
        require(not found,label+" existing edition.validate_text")
        errors.extend(found)
        validated+=1
        if name=="exercises": require(item.get("lines")==text.splitlines(),label+" lines/text synchronization")
        changed=[k for k in sorted(set(item)|set(old)) if item.get(k)!=old.get(k)]
        if changed: change_rows.append({"target":label,"source_refs":item.get("source_refs",item.get("pages",[])),"number":item.get("number"),"fields":changed,"text_changed":text!=old.get("text","")})
require([x["number"] for x in exercise["exercises"]]==[str(x) for x in range(204,238)],"all 34 tasks 204-237 in original order")
require(exercise["count"]==len(exercise["exercises"])==lesson["exercise_count"]==34,"task counts consistent")
require([x["id"] for x in lesson["figures"]]==["fig-38","fig-39","fig-40","fig-41"],"four original figure identities/placeholders")
require([x["id"] for x in lesson["prose"] if x.get("kind")=="fig"]==[x["id"] for x in lesson["figures"]],"placeholder order matches original figures")
for refs in [["p0070#1","p0070#4"],["p0071#2"]]:
    now=[x for x in lesson["prose"] if x.get("source_refs")==refs]
    before=[x for x in old_l["prose"] if x.get("source_refs")==refs]
    require(len(now)==len(before)==1 and now==before,"source anomaly block unchanged: "+",".join(refs))
flow=load(d/"prose-flow-03.stdout.txt")
require(len(lesson["section_breaks"])==len(flow["resolvedBreaks"])==5,"five concept boundaries resolved by existing prose_flow")
require(lesson["section_breaks"]==[{"before":x["before"],"after":x["after"]} for x in flow["boundaries"]],"authored anchors equal actual adjacent paragraphs")
require(len(flow["paragraphs"])==38,"actual prose_flow paragraphs")
verification=[]
allowed=set(base["mutablePaths"])
for item in base["baseline"]:
    if item["path"] in allowed: continue
    path=Path(item["path"])
    try:
        actual=bind(path)
        matched=actual["sha256"]==item["sha256"] and actual["bytes"]==item["bytes"]
    except OSError as e:
        actual={"path":str(path),"error":str(e)}
        matched=False
    verification.append({"expected":item,"actual":actual,"matches":matched})
    require(matched,"preexisting immutable bytes: "+str(path))
for snap in base["snapshots"]:
    actual=bind(Path(snap["snapshot"]["path"]))
    require(actual==snap["snapshot"],"prepared snapshot intact: "+actual["path"])
for doc in [lesson,exercise]:
    source=doc["source"]
    path=str(own/"artifacts/10c"/source["path"])
    matches=[x for x in verification if x["actual"]["path"]==path]
    require(len(matches)==1 and matches[0]["matches"] and matches[0]["actual"]["sha256"]==source["sha256"],"raw source binding: "+source["path"])
print(json.dumps({"schema":"stemrobin-184/n88-authored-text-check@1","errors":errors,"checks":checks,"templates":[bind(t/"lesson.template.json"),bind(t/"exercises.template.json")],"counts":{"lesson_prose_objects":len(lesson["prose"]),"actual_flow_paragraphs":len(flow["paragraphs"]),"section_breaks":len(flow["resolvedBreaks"]),"tasks":len(exercise["exercises"]),"figure_placeholders":len(lesson["figures"]),"validated_text_objects":validated,"exact_math_spans":exact_math,"nonformula_numeric_tokens":numeric,"lesson_text_edits":sum(x["text_changed"] for x in change_rows if x["target"].startswith("lesson")),"exercise_text_edits":sum(x["text_changed"] for x in change_rows if x["target"].startswith("exercises")),"immutable_baseline_files_verified_once":len(verification)},"changes":change_rows,"immutable_verification":verification,"sourceApproval":"NOTRUN","mathApproval":"NOTRUN","figureApproval":"NOTRUN","scienceApproval":"NOTRUN","displayApproval":"NOTRUN","modernTextApproval":"NOTRUN","completeLessons":0,"operations":{"image_opens":0,"image_decodes":0,"model_images":0,"renders":0,"OCR":0,"ROI":0,"network":0},"fees":"UNKNOWN"},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
sys.exit(0 if not errors else 2)
